stem: A pressurized irrigation component is shut off, but the gauge still shows pressure. What is the correct boundary decision?
choices: Preserve safe status and refer the pressure-release/disassembly work to the authorized servicing process.
Tap the gauge until pressure appears to fall.
Have a coworker hold the hose while opening it.
rationale: Preserve safe status and refer the pressure-release/disassembly work to the authorized servicing process. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
